pageDescription: Reviews left by the community ({count} published).
empty: No published review yet. Be the first to leave one!
emptyStars: No review with this rating yet.
averageLabel: Average rating: {avg} out of 5, from {count} ratings
inviteBody: Do you know us? Tell us in a few words what you think. It takes a minute.
formDescription: Write your review in a minute: it will be read before it is published.
formIntro: A few words are enough. Your review will be read before it is published, and you can withdraw it whenever you like.
hintName: It will be shown with your review. Example: Camille.
hintText: A few sentences, {max} characters at most.
hintEmail: Never published. It is only used to reply to you, and it is erased by itself after {days} days.
consentText: I agree that my review (text, rating and first name or nickname) is published on this site.
consentHint: You can withdraw it whenever you like.
sendHint: Your review will be read before it is published.
err_name: Write your first name or a nickname, for example “{example}”.
err_textShort: Your review is a bit short. Write at least one sentence, for example “Great welcome, I recommend it!”.
err_textLong: Your review is too long ({max} characters at most). Please shorten it a little.
err_links: There are too many links in your review. Keep one at most, or none.
err_email: This e-mail address looks incomplete. Example: camille@example.org.
err_consent: Tick the box so that your review can be published. Without your permission, it will not be.
draftGone: What you had written is no longer kept (30 minutes at most). You can write it again below.
thanksBody: Your review has arrived. It will be read before it is published, so it will not appear right away.
thanksState_pending: For now: waiting to be read.
thanksState_approved: It is published on the site.
withdrawIntro: **Keep this link to yourself.** It lets you withdraw your review at any time, without asking anyone. It is not sent by e-mail: copy it now.
withdrawCopy: Your link to withdraw your review
withdrawWarn: When you withdraw your review, it disappears from the site and what you wrote is erased (text, rating, e-mail address). This cannot be undone.
withdrawnBody: Your review has been withdrawn and erased. Thank you for writing to us.
waitBody: Many reviews are arriving right now. Please try again a little later.
mailBody: {name} has just left a review. It is waiting for you to read it:
adminStats: Average rating of published reviews: **{avg} out of 5** ({rated} ratings, {published} published reviews).
bannerPending: {count} reviews are waiting for you to read them. Nothing is published until you decide.
emptyAdmin: No review yet. Share the “Leave a review” link (Share tab): reviews will arrive here, under “To check”.
ok_reject: Review refused: it will not be published.
ok_pending: Review put back to check: it is no longer visible on the site.
okAdded: Review added: it is under “To check”.
errNotFound: This review no longer exists. Reload the page.
errNoConsent: This review has no permission to publish: it cannot be published.
errFull: There are already many reviews. Delete some before adding or publishing more.
searchHelp: In the names and texts of the reviews.
rejectedNote: Refused reviews are erased by themselves after {days} days.
moderationTip: Tip: read each review before deciding. Refuse unwanted or insulting messages, but not a review just because it is critical: that would skew the average rating.
exportHelp: A file for your spreadsheet: the reviews, the ratings, and the proof of each person's permission (date and wording).
addTextHelp: Copy the person's words, without changing them.
ownerConsentLabel: This person gave me permission to publish their review
ownerConsentHelp: Keep the proof (message, e-mail). Without permission, do not add it.
errOwnerConsent: Tick the box: without the person's permission, the review cannot be added.
ownerConsentRecord: Permission obtained by the site owner, outside the form.
editHelp: Only fix typing mistakes: these are the person's words.
photoHelp: Add it only if the person sent it to you for this.
positionHelp: A number from 1 to 9999, used when the order chosen in the settings is “By hand”. Example: 1.
clearEmailHelp: The review stays, only the address disappears.
errEditName: Write a first name or a nickname, for example Camille.
errEditText: The text of the review cannot be empty.
errEditRating: Choose a rating from 1 to 5, or “No rating”.
errEditPosition: Write a whole number from 1 to 9999, for example 1, or leave it empty.
shareHelp: Send this link in a message, put it in your descriptions or print the QR code below. The page works very well on a phone: one field at a time, big buttons.
qrAlt: QR code to the review form
shareHome: To show reviews on your home page: go to **Home**, add a section and choose “Featured reviews” (3 reviews by default).
shareNoPage: This module has no public page: give it an address in the General tab to get the link to share.
